title: [Discontinued] Farmy
description: Advanced Farming Overhaul with Skills, Gear, Pets, and much more
body:
# **❌ Discontinued ❌** # 🌾 Farmy (BETA) 🌾 **The Ultimate Next-Generation Farming Experience for PaperMC** [![PaperMC Supported](https://img.shields.io/badge/PaperMC-1.20%2B-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=paper)](#) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0%20BETA-orange?style=for-the-badge)](#) *Completely transform boring vanilla farming into a rich, rewarding, and visually stunning RPG progression system!* --- ![Level Up Celebration](https://media.giphy.com/media/ldUlb1koG5y97Vblvh/giphy.gif)
## ✨ About Farmy **Hi everyone! Welcome to Farmy.** I’ve been incredibly frustrated with how normal vanilla farming feels on servers. It usually just means players rush to build massive redstone auto-farms that lag the server and flood the economy on day one. I wanted to make farming *fun* again—like a real RPG. **Farmy** is my complete overhaul of the crop system! It introduces a fully interactive leveling pipeline where you actually get rewarded for *active* harvesting. I've added custom stats like Fortune and Wisdom, super cute companion pets that follow you around, crazy new gear, and tons of visual effects that make chopping down wheat feel incredibly satisfying. I really hope you guys enjoy it! --- ## 🚀 Core Features ### 📈 Dynamic Leveling & Progression Players start at **Farming Level 1** and unlock new crop types as they grind. * **Custom XP System:** Gain Farming XP by breaking fully-grown crops. * **BossBar Tracking:** A gorgeous, animated BossBar appears during harvesting to track XP progress dynamically. * **Level-Up Celebrations:** Epic screen titles, Ender Dragon growls, and localized Firework bursts when hitting a new level. * ![Level-Up Fireworks](https://media.giphy.com/media/ldUlb1koG5y97Vblvh/giphy.gif) ### 🛡️ Custom Farming Arsenal Ditch the standard hoes. Farmy introduces custom gear with raw RPG stats (`Farming Fortune` & `Farming Wisdom`): * **Tiered Armor Sets:** Craft/Obtain Wheat, Melon, Pumpkin, and Sugarcane Armor for massive permanent crop yield boosts. * **The Grand Scythe:** A beastly tool that harvests crops in a massive **3x3 or 5x5 radius**, perfect for late-game players. * **Blessed Plough:** Instantly fertilizes crops in a large area. * **Quality of Life Items:** Fortune Cookies (+5 Fortune permanently) and XP Boost bottles! * ![Custom Farming Gear](https://media.giphy.com/media/C2jTbjwM72zXJYMQua/giphy.gif) * ![Custom Farming Tools & Scythe](https://media.giphy.com/media/H4xTyHvdQ4ruyvCon5/giphy.gif) ### 🐾 Companion Farming Pets Never farm alone again! Summon fully customized companion pets that follow the player and trigger insane abilities: * 🐔 **The Chicken ("Eggsplosion"):** Unleashes a massive firework spiral and drops Golden Eggs that grant instant XP bursts. * 🐷 **The Pig ("Truffle Volcano"):** Digs furiously, causing a localized earthquake that erupts raw Emeralds and rare crops from the ground! * 🐮 **The Cow ("Holy Milk"):** Emits a 360-degree shockwave of bone-meal particles, instantly force-growing all crops in a large radius. * ![Pet Selection](https://media.giphy.com/media/xi5xI7tHzWFd1dSFaq/giphy.gif) * ![Pet Abilities](https://media.giphy.com/media/mZGjfSQPmSdD9TOM9f/giphy.gif) ### 💧 Automated Sprinklers & Blessed Land * **Animated Sprinklers:** Place custom Sprinkler blocks (ArmorStands) that visibly rotate and spray water particles in a 5x5 radius, gradually growing surrounding crops automatically! * **Boosted Farmland:** Special golden-particle dirt that permanently doubles crop yields for anything planted on it. * ![Animated Sprinklers in Action](https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcnUyd2I1anYycDZ2ZTlld2hldDd3d3N0Zmpnd3k2am1zdHh6czRpcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/X9bVkDZTAtvCAKoBtc/giphy.gif) ### ⚡ Enterprise-Grade Optimization Built for large active SMP networks. * **Pre-Calculated Math:** All exponential XP growth curves (`Math.pow()`) are statically compiled into RAM on startup. Zero lag during live harvesting. * **Chunk-Safe Iterators:** Background sprinkler tasks strictly enforce `isChunkLoaded()` checks, guaranteeing zero force-loaded chunk memory leaks. * **Database Synced:** Uses lightning-fast SQLite asynchronous saving to ensure player profiles (XP, levels, active pets) are never lost. --- ## 🛠️ Commands & Permissions *Crafting recipes are disabled by default. Admins must distribute gear via commands, kits, or server shops/crates.* * `/farming` - Opens the main Interactive GUI hub (Skills). * `/farming gear` - Opens the Gear & Tools catalog GUI directly. * `/farming pets` - Opens the Companion Pet selection GUI. * `/farming admin get ` - Admin command to spawn custom gear. * `/farming admin bypass` - Toggles the crop level requirement check for admins. * `/farming admin setlevel ` - Force set a player's Farming Level. * `/farming admin reload` - Reloads `config.yml` and `messages.yml` into memory. **Permissions:** * `farming.use` - Basic access to `/farming` GUIs (Default: true) * `farming.admin` - Access to all bypass, spawning tools, and reloads (Default: OP) --- ## ⚠️ Important BETA Notice Farmy is currently in **Public BETA**. The core engine is 100% stable, safe, and highly optimized for production servers. However, please note: 1. **Configuration:** Currently, custom items, colors, and GUI names are carefully integrated into the code for maximum aesthetic quality. A fully flexible `config.yml` / `messages.yml` is planned for the next major release to allow complete translation and personalization. 2. **Compatibility:** Be mindful when granting the "Grand Scythe" (Area of Effect tool) on servers utilizing claim plugins like WorldGuard, as the AoE sweep currently prioritizes speed over claim-checks. ---
## 💬 Support & Discord **A quick note from the developer:**
*This is my very first plugin! I've poured a lot of passion into making it as optimized and visually stunning as possible, but because it's so large, there will inevitably be some mistakes or bugs. I would absolutely love your feedback, suggestions, and patience as we improve it together!* [![Join Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Our%20Community-7289DA?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/tgbQhqJ8FA) *(Please use Discord for support rather than leaving bug reports in the reviews section!)*
